summary.headline: Judgments of Nocturnal Nativities
summary.text: Astrological judgment of two nocturnal nativities, explaining fortune through the Moon’s triplicity lords, planetary aspects, angularity, and house positions. The examples give detailed placements for Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, Mercury, the Moon, the Sun, the Part of Fortune, and the Head of the Dragon, including a Libra ascendant.
